name: Omarchy Iris
author: moerdowo
description: Your desktop's chief of staff, wearing a glass orb: an Omarchy-native companion that lives at the screen edge and takes orders through your configured AI agent. Unattended work runs inside a bubblewrap sandbox — read-only system, no home, no desktop sockets, no route to the network — and the three things that leave it ask you first: a host to reach, a command to run, a set of edits to publish. Its band of light is computed rather than blitted, so glass, tint and temper morph rather than cut.

barWidget.description: Ask, check status, and dress your desktop orb.
